en.headline: MTR senior manager loses HK$74 m in alleged green-bond scam
en.dek: Police are investigating after a 59-year-old expatriate reported being lured over two years by a caller posing as an HSBC UK private-bank employee into transferring funds to overseas accounts.
body: Hong Kong police are investigating a report that a 59-year-old senior manager at the MTR Corporation was allegedly defrauded of about HK$74 million in a two-year investment scam.

Police said the man reported receiving a phone call from a scammer claiming to be an employee of HSBC UK who persuaded him to invest in purported green bonds. Following the caller’s instructions, he made 12 transfers totalling roughly HK$74 million to designated overseas bank accounts, including one at Barclays Bank in the United Kingdom, between February 2024 and January 2026.

According to police, the victim later failed to recover the funds, suspected he had been scammed and reported the matter. The case has been classified as obtaining property by deception. No arrests have been made.
Sources indicated the victim is an expatriate working at the MTR Corporation. Police said the investigation continues.

zh.headline: 港鐵高級經理疑遭綠色債券騙案損失7400萬元
zh.dek: 一名59歲外籍港鐵高級經理報稱兩年間被冒充英國滙豐私人銀行職員的來電誘騙，向海外戶口轉帳約7400萬元，警方正調查。
body: 香港警方正調查一宗報案，指一名59歲港鐵公司高級經理涉嫌在兩年內被騙去約7400萬元。
警方表示，事主報稱接到自稱英國滙豐銀行職員的來電，對方游說他投資所謂綠色債券。他其後按指示先後12次向指定海外銀行戶口（包括英國巴克萊銀行戶口）轉帳，合共約7400萬元，時間介乎2024年2月至2026年1月。
警方指事主其後未能取回款項，懷疑受騙並報案。案件列為以欺騙手段取得財產，暫無人被捕。
消息指事主為外籍人士，在港鐵任職。警方表示調查仍在進行。
